# Robin Farrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Ten years old at the end of Volume 5  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004), [v5 c3 P8](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v5 c35 P6](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Marysville, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v4 c21 P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr. Robin Farrow  <sub>[v1 c17 P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Robin-boy  <sub>[v3 c22 P5](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0005), [v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Robin is a fair-haired boy with a round skull covered in fuzzy, yellow ringlets and a round, rosy, smiling face. He has mischievous hazel eyes, a snub nose, and a single dimple in his cheek that gives him a sweet, uneven look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v3 c1 P2](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Robin is an energetic, restless, and mischievous boy who constantly finds himself in trouble due to a lack of impulse control. He is naturally inquisitive, asking endless questions about how the world works, though he often struggles to understand abstract rules or morality until they are carefully explained. Despite his impish behavior, he possesses an affectionate and loving heart, cares deeply for Nell, and genuinely wants to be good.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v2 c8 P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), [v2 c10 P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

## History

Robin was raised in Marysville by his impoverished mother after his father passed away in an accident. Following his mother's death, Thirza Abernethy adopted Robin and his twin sister, Lucy, bringing them to live at Grey Shutters in Brierley. From his arrival, Robin kept the household on its toes with his boundless energy and inclination for mischief, from dropping a caterpillar down a girl's collar at church to locking his sister in a toolhouse. He developed a deep attachment to Nell Harcourt, who patiently guided his behavior and answered his relentless questions. Over the years, Robin attended the local school, formed close friendships with the neighborhood children, and gradually matured into a well-meaning, industrious boy who assisted with chores on the farm. Though he frequently tested the patience of Thirza and Mrs. Sowerby, his warm-hearted nature made him a cherished member of the Grey Shutters family.

_Sources: [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c3 P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 c8 P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 c10 P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 c27 P20](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0020), [v4 c31 P9](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0009)_
